coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Data Platform Manager position at Molson Coors in Milwaukee. My background combines hands-on software development, systems integration, project coordination, and client support. At DSTax Technologies, I serve as a Manager, technical lead, and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, connecting financial systems with tax providers and supporting implementation from requirements gathering through go-live. The role's combination of technical leadership, platform evolution, and collaboration with business stakeholders offers a clear connection to that experience.

At DSTax Technologies, I led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the platform, broadening financial-platform and tax-provider support and improving UI/UX. I also optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput and migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. Alongside development, I managed internal projects and client-coordinated work, communicated status, answered implementation questions, and maintained client documentation. This work required connecting platform changes with operational needs while supporting the systems clients depended on. Earlier, at Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), I analyzed asset and facilities databases and identified more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value, informing the sale of unused assets before the acquisition. I also implemented a global mapping platform, initiated web automations that reduced manual database maintenance, and designed SharePoint data-input forms to improve accessibility and reduce errors. That experience demonstrates how I approach technical improvements in the context of practical business decisions.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this background could contribute to Molson Coors' data platform priorities. The opportunity to connect platform engineering with supply chain, manufacturing, and commercial decisions is particularly relevant to the integration and operational work described above. Thank you for considering my application and for the opportunity to discuss the position.

Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized platform modernization, AWS migration, asynchronous performance, integration delivery, stakeholder coordination, and business-focused database analysis. The master does not establish Databricks, data lake or warehouse infrastructure, ML engineering, large-scale distributed data processing, data governance, or engineering-team coaching experience. It also does not establish the required eight years in cloud data architecture/data and ML engineering or five years with data lake, warehousing, and analytics tools. Python and database technologies are listed, but SQL programming depth and data modeling expertise are not documented.
